candidates.description: This vector represents geographical regions, continents, and geopolitical landmasses.
This vector represents institutional, organizational, and geographical proper nouns or place names across multiple languages.
This feature vector activates on fragments and terms related to European languages and scripts, particularly Hindi and various European languages.
This feature activates for multilingual subwords and character fragments related to sustainable energy terms.
This vector represents subword fragments and characters from various languages, particularly Hindi and English.
This feature vector represents the Devanagari vowel sign "ṛ" combined with various consonants and related proper noun fragments.
This feature vector activates on specific Brahmi-derived Indic vowel sign and consonant-vowel ligatures, along with unrelated character fragments like "Queensland" and "istry".
These tokens represent common Hindi vowel sign combinations, dependent vowel modifiers, and frequent sub-word suffixes in the Devanagari script.
These tokens represent common prefixes and characters starting with the Devanagari vowel 'आ' (aa).
This vector represents dependent vowel signs and diacritics used in Indic scripts like Devanagari.
